draft.text: You came in because you have sharp pain in your right elbow that started a week ago after playing lacrosse with your kids.
You have pain that gets worse when you move your elbow, and it radiates down your forearm.
There is swelling and bruising around your elbow, and you have trouble moving it because of the pain.
The pain is likely from a soft tissue injury or damage to the ligaments in your elbow.
We will talk about the next steps at your follow-up appointment, including reviewing imaging results and discussing treatment options.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have had sharp pain in your right elbow for one week.
The pain started after you played lacrosse with your kids.
You have pain that gets worse when you move your elbow, especially when bending or straightening it.
The pain goes down your forearm.
There is swelling and bruising around the tip of your elbow.
You have trouble moving your elbow because of the pain.
The pain is likely from an injury to the soft tissues or ligaments in your elbow.
More tests, like an MRI or ultrasound, will be done to look at the injury.
We will talk about the results and next steps at your follow-up appointment.
